scope: Development-profile diagnostic and native executables, matching the deployed service; no release-profile claim. Final compiled source and initial prototype are distinct observations. Four serial ABBA sampling runs plus one subsequent candidate/original quiet pair, warm OS/tool caches, fresh private namespaces, actual unchanged confined worker protocol/policy/bounds. Setup, output comparison and hashing excluded. No concurrent test, build or other metric sampler during measurement. CPU excludes child processes; nested/parallel spans are not additive.
